author: Phenss
attribution: Photo: Phenss, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:TheofisKakabona.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hanging board under a small thatched roof, hostel/café in Kakabona west of Honiara; the 'O' is drawn as a brush circle. Panoramic, so the sign is small in the frame. A parked car's number plate is visible but incidental. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Phenss
attribution: Photo: Phenss, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Panoramic_photo_of_Police_Memorial_Park,_Children%27s_Adventure_Land,_Rove_Honiara_Solomon_Islands.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted yellow panel on an angled white wall, Rove, Honiara; seen obliquely. Small sponsor lines below ('Proudly Sponsored by: Island Manufacturing Ltd, Rotary Club of Honiara, ... Bankers Association, British High Commission, Islands Road Works') are partly cut off and not transcribed. Scribbled graffiti on the panel. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Panoramic photo of Police Memorial Park, Children's Adventure Land, Rove Honiara Solomon Islands.jpg

author: Phenss
attribution: Photo: Phenss, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Photo_of_Police_Memorial_Park,_Rove_Honiara_Solomon_Islands.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Same sign style as c39852446 but a different park. The 'P' of PARK has fallen off, leaving only a small fragment, so the sign visibly reads 'MEMORIAL ARK'. The third line is cut by the bottom frame edge ('Co...' = Committee). A yellow 'APRIL YOUTH MARKET 21ST - 24TH' flyer on the wall is a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Photo of Police Memorial Park, Rove Honiara Solomon Islands.jpg

author: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
attribution: Photo: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SOLS0262_(10721930374).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Village peace-campaign board on a woven-bamboo house on Malaita. The mark in BI'O is a slanted tick (apostrophe/glottal-style mark), transcribed as ASCII apostrophe. Small logo texts (Peace Monitoring Council Solomon Islands, Community Peace and Restoration Fund, AusAID) not transcribed.

author: Phenss
attribution: Photo: Phenss, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Panoramic_photo_of_Botanical_Gardens,_Rove_Honiara_Solomon_Islands._Note_the_hanging_spot_marked_on_the_sign.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Map-and-information board in a narrow panorama. Only the headings are transcribed; the small paragraph text (walking tracks, rubbish bins, toilet, swimming pool, BBQ area, guided tours, venue hire, phone/email) and map labels (ROVE PRISON, LENGAKIKI, TASAHE, Walks legend) are too small to transcribe reliably. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Panoramic photo of Botanical Gardens, Rove Honiara Solomon Islands. Note the hanging spot marked on the sign.jpg

author: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
attribution: Photo: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign._Solomon_Islands_2004._Photo-_Peter_Davis_-_AusAID_(10721407036).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.text: THROUGH WORKING IN PARTNERSHIP FOR PEACE
WITH THE PEOPLE OF GUADALCANAL PROVINCE

notes: Blue project board for a kindergarten in Aruligo, Guadalcanal. The white board beside it reads 'ARULIGO VATUKULAU Community is now WEAPONS FREE! PLEASE RESPECT OUR WISHES' (UNDP/AusAID logos) and also names the place. Logo micro-text not transcribed.
source_title: File:Sign. Solomon Islands 2004. Photo- Peter Davis - AusAID (10721407036).jpg
